history.cause: The source audit's own expectation line above the Tier-H marker contained two forbidden tokens contiguously, so the audit matched its own source.
history.remediation: Split every forbidden token into separate literals; the assertion was not removed or weakened.

history.cause: Explicit macOS 15.4+ NSPasteboard access behavior .alwaysDeny was not modeled, so a denied read degraded to internal.unclassified.
history.remediation: Added an internal AppKit-free MacPasteboardReadAccess seam; the live seam maps only .alwaysDeny to explicitlyDenied behind if #available(macOS 15.4, *); readPlainText returns the frozen permission.capabilityUnavailable / error / userActionRequired / notRequired failure before any count, type or content observation; four deterministic tests added; writes are not blocked.
history.verification: Current suite passes: 63 passed, 0 failures. Real .alwaysDeny not exercised; see remainingRisks R-a.

history.remediation: Formatting-only edits in the test file; no behavior or assertion change.

remainingRisks.summary: A real general-pasteboard .alwaysDeny state was not exercised; changing OS state and reading the global clipboard would be intrusive. Covered by the seam and compilation only.
changeCount is not an atomic transaction token; concurrent writers can change the pasteboard between observations.
NSPasteboard materializes the String before the byte limit can be checked.
